       entity_id = ent.get("id")

       if isinstance(entity_id, str):
          # if duplicate, spec unique. If duplicate with diff type? last? We need not. Unique. To avoid modifying. Could choose last like dict assignment. 
          entity_types[entity_id] = entity_type
    edges={}
    issues=[]
    for assertion in assertions or []:
       source_id = assertion.get("source_id") if isinstance(assertion, dict) else None
      if not isinstance(source_id, str) or source_id == "":
          issues.append({"source_id":"", "reason":"missing_source"})
          continue
       relation=... 
       if relation not in relation_types:
          issues.append({"source_id":source_id, "reason":"unknown_relation"})
          continue
       subject=...
       obj=...
       if not isinstance(subject,str) or subject not in entity_types or not isinstance(obj,str) or obj not in entity_types:
          issues.append({"source_id":source_id, "reason":"missing_entity"})
          continue
       expected = relation_types[relation]
       actual_s=entity_types.get(subject)
       actual_o=entity_types.get(obj)
       if (actual_s, actual_o)!= expected:
          issues.append({... type_mismatch})
          continue
       key=(subject, relation, obj)
       edges.setdefault(key, []).append(source_id)
    edges_list=[]
    for key in sorted(edges.keys()):  # sorting key of strings
       subject, relation, obj = key
       evidence = sorted(set(edges[key]))
       edges_list.append({"subject":subject,"relation":relation,"object":obj,"evidence":evidence})
    issues.sort(key=lambda item: (item["source_id"], item["reason"]))
    return {"edges": edges_list, "issues": issues}
